Neat little blaster. Its everything S&W airweight would like to be, but isn't. Weighs a bit more, but still less than a can of beer. Holds 13 rounds instead of 5. I saw all kinds of reviews, and a lot of people noted that is "has quite a bit more kick". But not much really. It is more....but its not a lot. Nowhere near a .357 or anything like that. Just a bit more recoil than a normal 9mm striker fired gun. Another surprise is that i was able to have a full grip with the pinky extender.

Trigger is what you would expect from a striker fired gun. Nothing to love, but it works. I would still prefer the safety and the finesse of DA/SA, but it is what it is.
